## History

Thomas Lynde was ruled by his mother throughout his early life until he married [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who took over the role, and he planted June lilies at the time of their wedding. After Thomas passed away, his widow [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) was invited by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so she would not have to leave [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

_Sources: [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P13](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0013), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P35](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0035), [v3 ch.Home P14](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0014)_

## Relationships

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/rachel-lynde--thomas-lynde.md)

Thomas Lynde was the husband of [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) until his death. The two resided together in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), where [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) was known for her active involvement in community affairs and local gossip. Following Thomas's passing, [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) was left without a household, prompting [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to invite her to move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), +16 more_
